expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation
expectations.evidence: Staged 7-milestone plan with only M1 marked ✅ ('| 1 ✅ | init |'), M2 listed as '### M2 hash-object / cat-file — 待开始' with a TODO list; mygit.py (4825 chars) implements only the init subcommand, matching the user's explicit '只完成第一阶段' — first milestone only, not a complete implementation.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Verification section gives concrete commands with expected behaviour: 'git status → On branch master / No commits yet'；'git fsck 退出码 0'；real git 'add + commit（a4834a9）成功'；'对已有仓库重复 init 正确报错退出'. Each milestone row also carries a checkpoint, e.g. M2: 'mygit hash-object -w f 的 SHA 与 git hash-object f 一致'.

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (git-git-wyag-thb-lt): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
expectations.evidence: Milestones mirror wyag's actual stages (init → hash-object/cat-file → write-tree/ls-tree → commit-tree/log → index add/status → checkout/branch → clone/push/packfile) with tutorial-specific concepts: '"blob <len>\0<data>"'、SHA-1、zlib、'objects/xx/yyyy…'、'20 字节原始 SHA'、'二进制 index v2'、'pkt-line、packfile 解析、delta'. Agent fetched the tutorial to confirm init artifacts ('教程原文已确认：init 阶段创建 branches/ objects/ refs/tags/ refs/heads/…'), and code follows wyag §3.1–3.2 (GitRepository, repo_create writing 'ref: refs/heads/master', repositoryformatversion=0/filemode=false/bare=false, repo_find).

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); asks the learner to install if needed
expectations.evidence: No install commands were run, but the agent wrote outside the project dir: 'curl -sL https://wyag.thb.lt/ -o /tmp/wyag.html && wc -c /tmp/wyag.html' (plus converted /tmp/wyag.txt read via 'sed -n 560,780p /tmp/wyag.txt'), 'mkdir /tmp/t1', 'python3 mygit.py init /tmp/t1 && find /tmp/t1/.git', 'touch /tmp/probe' — all target /tmp, outside the project dir.
